text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes first in the Kikuka Sho.
The
audience is thrilled that she
managed to
overcome the limitations of
her distance aptitude
and conquer a
long-distance race. Their
expectations
rise ever higher.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, she asks to participate in
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a
1,200-meter G1 turf
sprint.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm puzzled by her sudden change of
heart, but
I'm sure she has a reason.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
